notes.title: Pre-Release Demo - The Backrooms: Rescue Expedition
notes.content: [p]We're launching the demo for The Backrooms: Rescue Expedition for one month only![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45259913/976ae6c0f0d9e3dccfc1318952f9eafaf163979a.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Choose one of the available roles with your friends and venture into the depths of the Backrooms to rescue the lost team.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]What's included:[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Online cooperative multiplayer.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][list][*][p]Two atmospheric levels.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][list][*][p]Proximity voice chat.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]The demo will only be available for a limited time, so don't miss your chance to be part of the expedition![/p]
